verdict.rationale: Metronome documents API-driven subscription lifecycle management, including upgrades, downgrades, and seat changes (docs-6, docs-31). It also suggests powering end-customer pages and an in-product billing dashboard (docs-28, docs-11). However, nothing in the evidence shows a hosted portal or embeddable components that let customers self-serve plan changes or cancellations, so the founder would have to build that UI on the API. Missing for 10: a hosted self-serve customer portal, embeddable upgrade/downgrade/cancel components, documented customer-initiated cancellation flow, and independent corroboration.
